name: PPT Master
description: AI generates natively editable PPTX from any document — PDF/DOCX/URL/Markdown to real PowerPoint shapes (DrawingML). Multi-role collaboration pipeline: Strategist → Image Generator → Executor → Post-processing → Export.

projectsDir.title: Project workspace directory
projectsDir.description: Absolute path where generated PPT projects are stored. Defaults to plugin dataDir/projects/.

pythonPath.title: Python interpreter path
pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter for running scripts. Defaults to 'python3' on macOS/Linux, 'python' on Windows.
